name: Classic
title: Free Classic Invoice Template
description: A free classic invoice template set in Garamond: your letterhead, billing details and a clear amount due. Fill it in online and download a professional PDF.
summary: Garamond letterhead on the left, the invoice number on the right. Folio’s original.
intro: Your name set as a letterhead, the invoice number opposite, and the amount due stated once, beside the date it is due. An invoice that reads like correspondence from an established business.
explanation: The classic invoice is laid out like a business letter, because for most of the history of invoicing that is what it was. Clients still read it that way: who it is from at the top left, who it is to beneath, then what it is for, what it costs and how to pay.

This template sets your name and logo in Garamond as a letterhead, places the invoice number in a quiet serif on the right, and gathers billed-to, issue date, due date and amount due on one line. Totals sit in a narrow column; payment details and notes at the foot.

It suits almost anyone: consultants, studios, shops, sole traders and professional practices. If your brand uses a sans-serif, the [Modern template](/invoice-templates/modern/) keeps the same arrangement in Grotesk.

fields.name: Letterhead
fields.text: Your logo, business name and contact details, top left, as on headed paper.

fields.name: Invoice number
fields.text: Set opposite the letterhead, where clients and bookkeepers look for it first.

fields.name: Billed to and dates
fields.text: The client, issue date, due date and amount due on one line, so the essentials are read together.

fields.name: Line items
fields.text: Description, quantity, unit price and amount, with figures aligned in tabular numerals.

fields.name: Totals
fields.text: Subtotal, discount, tax, any shipping or other charge, and the total, in a narrow column on the right.

fields.name: Payment and notes
fields.text: How to pay you, and a short note, at the foot of the page.

steps.title: Open the example
steps.text: Customize this invoice opens the classic example in the generator; Start with a blank one opens it empty.

steps.title: Your details once
steps.text: Enter your business details and logo. They are remembered for every invoice after this one.

steps.title: The client and the work
steps.text: Add the client and each item. Tax, discount and totals are calculated as you type.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download a vector PDF with the typefaces embedded, or print it.

faqs.q: What is a classic invoice layout?
faqs.a: One arranged like a business letter: sender at the top left, recipient beneath, the invoice number and dates near the top, items in a table, totals on the right and payment details at the bottom. Most accounting software uses a version of it, which is why clients find it easy to read.

faqs.q: Can I switch to another template later?
faqs.a: Yes. Change template from the generator at any time; your details, items and totals stay exactly as they are.
